headline: Four major new businesses in the Kaohsiung zone before year-end; industry hopes for tax incentives for talent | Industry news
summary: The Financial Supervisory Commission expects four major businesses to be added to the Kaohsiung zone before year-end. Measures include removing the 99-person subscriber limit for unregistered offshore funds.
why: The Financial Supervisory Commission is Taiwan's financial regulator, and its rules determine how offshore funds and banks can serve wealth management clients.
